description: This file handles inbound iMessage processing, including message validation, echo detection, reflection guard, permission checks, and context building for inbound messages in an iMessage integration module.

classes.name: IMessageReplyContext
classes.description: Represents the reply context of an inbound message, including optional reply ID, body, and sender.

methods.name: normalizeReplyField
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a string or undefined, trimming strings and converting numbers to strings.

methods.name: describeReplyContext
methods.description: Creates a reply context object from a message payload, extracting reply-to text, ID, and sender.

methods.name: resolveInboundEchoMessageIds
methods.description: Extracts message IDs and GUIDs from a message payload for echo detection.

methods.name: hasIMessageEchoMatch
methods.description: Checks if the message or its IDs match recent sent messages to detect echoes.

methods.name: resolveIMessageInboundDecision
methods.description: Determines whether to dispatch, drop, or pair a message based on validation, permissions, and content analysis.

methods.name: buildIMessageInboundContext
methods.description: Builds the context payload for an inbound iMessage, including formatted envelope, labels, and history.

methods.name: buildIMessageEchoScope
methods.description: Constructs a scope string for echo detection based on account, chat, and sender.

methods.name: describeIMessageEchoDropLog
methods.description: Generates a log message for skipped echo messages, including a preview of message text.
